warnings.desc: HEAVY RAINFALL which may lead to FLASH FLOODING is possible about parts of the South West and Lower West districts. Six-hourly rainfall totals between 30 and 60 mm are expected, with possible localised falls up to 90 mm. Heavy falls are expected to ease on Wednesday during the early evening. Locations which may be affected include Bunbury, Busselton, Mandurah, Collie, Harvey and Dwellingup. 52.8 mm was recorded east of Busselton in the 2 hours to 9:30pm
